scientific_integrity: Exact arithmetic and analytic all-degree bounds; standalone checker; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp bound concerns nonsingular exact-degree Legendre sampling on 15 antipodal representatives of the 30 icosidodecahedral vertices. Earlier rank classification is not new. Historic equivalents, especially inaccessible older icosahedral harmonic literature, remain an originality risk. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: The unique worst-conditioned exact-degree harmonic sampler on the icosidodecahedron
